stories.title: Alaska Senate election: DOJ wants to 'segregate' all ballots for 2nd Sullivan candidate
stories.summary: The DOJ wants to keep ballots for the second Dan Sullivan in the Alaska Senate race for a potential investigation. The U.S. attorney in Alaska said Friday that a criminal investigation of the state's U.S. Senate race is "ongoing.". The probe is occurring as the Department of Justice pursues a related civil lawsuit to block quick certification of…

stories.title: Meta outlook revised downward by S&P on cash flow and capex concerns
stories.summary: Meta has been given a negative outlook by S&P Global Ratings due to the company's hefty capital expenditures and negative free cash flow. S&P said the outlook reflects uncertainty around elevated capital expenditures and future cash flow. Meta reported quarterly earnings last week.

stories.title: This cybersecurity stock will be the next to join the S&P 500
stories.summary: Okta is slated to join the index on Wednesday, replacing Kenvue.

stories.title: Why gold plunged to its lowest price in a year despite renewed Iran jitters
stories.summary: Safe-haven gold fell to its lowest price in a year, despite jitters around the potential for fresh Middle East attacks following the U.S. midterm elections on Tuesday

stories.summary: Intel’s PC business is under pressure as memory-chip prices dent demand and as corporate IT teams have less budget for laptops.

sports.title: Thunder say Holmgren out 8-10 weeks after knee procedure
sports.summary: Chet Holmgren will be out eight to 10 weeks because of a knee injury, the latest setback for an OKC team that lost Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace for an extended time early this week.

sports.title: Sources: Walter, Kushner finalize terms of Lakers sale at $12.5B valuation
sports.summary: Lakers owner Mark Walter and Thrive Capital founder Josh Kushner met Thursday to finalize the transaction and are expected to sign the formal agreement soon, sources told ESPN.

sports.title: Sources: Hart winner Kucherov, 33, requests trade from Lightning
sports.summary: Tampa Bay Lightning forward Nikita Kucherov, in the final year of his contract, has requested a trade, sources told ESPN Friday, but general manager Julien BriseBois made a statement on social media, saying the team has "no intention of trading" the star.

sports.title: Morant, hurt against Grizzlies, to miss at least four weeks
sports.summary: Trail Blazers guard Ja Morant sustained a left hamstring strain in his first game against the Grizzlies, his former team, and will be out for at least four weeks.
